leverage.exposure: No leverage is open. The balance is positive and there is nothing to unwind before the lock. The recommended move would deliberately open a leveraged position at the moment the auction settles, and that is why the bid is capped where it is: a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, which outranks every other consideration on this page. The unwind is a single instant sale to Kickbase at market value, available at any time, and it resolves roughly three days before the lock. The residual risk is the daily market-value tick moving the funding sale down between the auction settling and the sale being made, which is what the headroom in the bid is for. Fallback if it ever came to it: selling a second body and eating the squad-minimum penalty is strictly better than being negative at kickoff.

binding_gap: Not a formation hole — the shape is legal and fillable. The gap is quality inside a squad with no bench: an unavailable midfielder is occupying a starting place because there is no twelfth body to replace him with. Defence is where the board actually offers value, and the fix is to buy a fit, confirmed starter and let the unavailable man fund him.

verdict.headline: One move matters this run and it is the one already on the table, re-priced.
verdict.headline_short: One move matters this run and it is the one already on the table, re-p
verdict.detail: One move matters this run and it is the one already on the table, re-priced. Bid for Pinckert at the affordability ceiling and, only if that lands, sell Lokonga to unwind. Nothing else on the board clears both the points test and the money test. No leveraged position is open right now and the matchday lock is still days away, so there is no emergency — but there is a genuine points gain sitting in a single swap, and it is worth bidding for even at odds that favour losing, because a lost auction costs nothing.

sell.reason: Lokonga, and only conditionally. The case is availability rather than quality and it is freshly sourced: HSV reported acute back trouble the day before this run, he missed the last matchday with a replacement starting in his place, and the club's probable XI leaves him out. Kickbase's own status flag agrees. The old February injury item that keeps surfacing is last season and must stay ignored. Execution order is not optional — buy first, sell second — because selling first drops the squad below the minimum. If the auction is lost, this sale does not happen at all. Widmer remains the other obvious candidate on merit, fit but a substitute in both matchdays so far, and he is not sellable this run because he does not raise enough to fund anything and selling him alone would breach the squad minimum.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: THE UNWIND. This is the pre-priced second leg of the Conte trade and it is now due. Conte (3204) settled to Georg Kitz 2026-09-05T12:52:14Z at 12.000.000 against mv 9.292.405 = +29,14%, exactly the Brncinm call, and the balance is now -566.376. Selling Amoako to Kickbase at mv 1.569.143 puts it at +1.002.767 and closes the leveraged position outright. REVERSES AND CLOSES Hjmhal7, WHICH SAID DO NOT SELL HIM - say that out loud to Georg. Hjmhal7 was right on its own premise and the premise is dead: it protected Amoako as the ELEVENTH BODY of an 11-man squad, where selling him meant 10 players and the -100 penalty. Conte makes the squad TWELVE, so Amoako is now the twelfth body and the sale is free. POINTS COST ZERO, MEASURED: Amoako has no ap field at all (0 points, 0 minutes, 0 apps, 2x unused sub per Ligainsider 05.09.2026), so he leaves the fielded eleven at 12 players anyway. Squad after the sale is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/3MID/3ATT, which IS 4-3-3 exactly, legal, fully placed, fielded points 1439. HE IS THE RIGHT BODY AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS MEASURED: selling Widmer instead (mv 1.852.587, +283.444 more cash) forces 3-4-3 and costs 29 fielded points; selling Lokonga (mv 9.731.816) forces Amoako back into the eleven and costs 44. Amoako is the only points-free sale on the books. TIMING - SELL BEFORE 20:00Z: market values tick at 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z (mvud, first-party) and Amoako is decaying hard - tfhmvt -49.393, sdmvt -811.827 - so every tick he is held costs ~50k of unwind. There is no matchday risk forcing the hand (MD3 locks 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~149,6h away, and MD2's lock passed 04.09 18:30Z with the balance still at +11.433.624, so no scored matchday has ever seen the negative), but there is no reason on earth to wait either. AFTER THIS THE SQUAD IS AT 11 AND FULLY INVESTED: cash ~1,00M, zero further sales possible without triggering -100, so the usable buy ceiling is ~1,00M and nothing on the board is reachable. That is the correct state, not a problem to solve.

standing.name: Sambi Lokonga
standing.why: THE UNWIND LEG OF BUY Bsmq4uu - CONDITIONAL, AND THE CONDITION IS NOT OPTIONAL. Sell him ONLY once Rohr has actually landed (check get_squad, per H5om1wi do not trust the calibration table's [executed] flag). At 11 players a sale is a -100 penalty; at 12 it is free. If the Rohr auction is lost, CLOSE THIS CALL AND KEEP HIM - this supersedes nothing about his standing block, which already says exactly that. WHY HIM AND NOT CONTE, the only other candidate: on points they are a coin flip (Lokonga ap 44 v Conte ap 47, so Conte is fractionally better and the Lokonga route is worth +3 fielded points because it keeps Widmer 29 in a 5-2-3 rather than dropping Conte 47 from a 5-3-2 - 1283 v 1280). The tiebreak is the money. Lokonga is BLEEDING: mvt 2, sdmvt -1.125.317, i.e. roughly -1,1M a day, and he is the worst points-per-euro in the squad at 9.731.816 / 44 = 221k per point. Conte is RISING hard: mvt 1, sdmvt +1.284.273, tfhmvt +93.437. Sell the decaying asset and keep the appreciating one. SELECTION CUTS THE OTHER WAY AND IS DELIBERATELY OVERRIDDEN: Lokonga is a confirmed HSV starter (no news dated 04.09.2026 or later; note the hsv.de "Verletzungsupdate zu Sambi Lokonga" ankle-ligament story is 09.02.2026 = LAST SEASON and was correctly discarded again this run), while Conte was BENCHED by Hoffenheim v Dortmund on 05.09.2026 (sport.de liveticker; rotated for Lemperle and Rots). That argues for selling Conte instead. It is outweighed by the mv trajectories: Conte benched but appreciating is still the better asset to hold, and a start is not points. FORMATION DEPENDENCY, THE ONE THING THAT COULD FORCE THE SWITCH: this route leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT and needs 5-2-3 to be selectable. If the app does not offer 5-2-3, sell CONTE instead (9.292.405, leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2, definitely legal, 1280 fielded, and the bid was sized so that route also stays positive at +45.172). Verify the shape in-app before clicking; do not discover it after the sale. Instant-sale to Kickbase pays exactly mv, measured 8 for 8.

standing.name: Albert Sambi Lokonga
standing.why: THE UNWIND LEG OF BUY Bd8oqv9 - CONDITIONAL, AND THE TIMING WINDOW IS THE WHOLE POINT. Fires ONLY if Rohr lands at ~00:57Z; if the auction is lost, do NOT sell, the squad is 11 and legal at 4-3-3. (1) WHY HIM. ap 44 on mv 9.771.142 = 222k per fielded point, the worst points-per-euro body in the squad that is large enough to fund the buy (Widmer is cheaper per point but only 1,9M, nowhere near the 10,7M needed). Selling him leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT = 5-2-3, legal; fielded eleven 1226 - 44 + 101 = 1283. Selling Conte instead gives 5-3-2 at 1280 AND realises a 2,5M loss on a player bought today at 12.000.000, so Lokonga is strictly better on both counts. (2) THE TIMING RULE, WHICH SUPERSEDES "SELL IMMEDIATELY". CORRECTED CLUB FACT: Lokonga is HAMBURGER SV, not Leipzig - ligainsider 2026/27 profile says Hamburger SV, and the lineup `os` field (MD3 opponent) reads RBL, mirroring Nusa's HSV. tid 6 = HSV; record it. HSV have NOT yet played MD2 (mdst 0) - they play Sunday 06.09. Selling a player before his matchday game forfeits his MD2 points. SO: SELL AFTER HSV'S SUNDAY MATCH ENDS (~17:30Z) AND BEFORE THE 20:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK. In that window mv is fixed at 9.771.142 and the unwind is arithmetically certain: 1.002.767 - 10.700.000 + 9.771.142 = +73.909. (3) IF THE WINDOW IS MISSED the position is not urgent - MD3 does not lock until 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~142h out - but the buffer is only 73.909, so a downward tick on Lokonga (sdmvt -1.060.385, i.e. he has been drifting down) puts the balance negative. A NEGATIVE BALANCE AT MD3 KICKOFF SCORES ZERO FOR THE ENTIRE MATCHDAY. Emergency fallback if Lokonga's mv slips below ~9,70M: sell Minjae (12.237.277) or Matsima (14.399.505) instead - both clear it with room, at a real points cost, and both keep a legal shape. Do not let the buffer be the reason the position is left open. (4) NEWS: no dated item since 03.08.2026 ("Lokonga mischt wieder mit"); absent from ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte 05.09; 81% Einsatzquote, 4,0 average, 26th among central midfielders. He is FIT and probably starting - this is a QUALITY sale, not an availability one, and the case rests entirely on 222k per point being the worst funding cost in the squad. GEORG EXECUTES; this task never places trades.

standing.name: Sambi Lokonga

The alternatives are all worse: ter Horst (DEF, ap 92) gives only +9 AND at mv 9.046.121 does not even clear the 9.697.233 shortfall; Onyeka (MID, ap 108) costs 108 to save 44; Minjae (DEF, ap 110) and Matsima (DEF, ap 138) are larger unwinds that cost more fielded points than Rohr adds; Widmer (DEF, ap 29) would be the best points outcome at 4-3-3 for 1298 (+72) but at mv 1.897.252 he cannot fund a 10,7M purchase. Lokonga is the worst points-per-euro body in the squad large enough to do the job: 9.771.142 / 44 = 222k per fielded point. PRICE IS LOCKED: market values update once daily at 20:00Z, so 9.771.142 holds for the whole window and the post-unwind balance is 1.002.767 - 10.700.000 + 9.771.142 = +73.909. FITNESS/SELECTION VERIFIED, AND IT IS NOT THE REASON FOR THE SALE: Ligainsider's HSV page has him in the probable XI, and he is absent from Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table fetched this run. The case is quality, not availability. INSTRUMENT: instant sale to Kickbase pays exactly mv - measured 8 for 8. GEORG EXECUTES; this task never places trades.

standing.name: Albert Sambi Lokonga
standing.why: SUPERSEDES S2a0qej (closed, restated — not reversed). The unwind leg of BUY Pinckert. AVAILABILITY, NOT QUALITY: dated 06.09.2026, HSV report acute back trouble ("akute Rueckenbeschwerden"), he missed MD2 v Mainz with Bilal Nadir starting in his place, and the 07.09.2026 Ligainsider profile flags him "angeschlagen" and leaves him out of the HSV predicted XI. Kickbase agrees: st 2. He is NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table, so this is a short knock, not a lay-off — but he is currently a fielded body scoring nothing. ap 44, mv 9.775.944, sells to Kickbase at mv. STALE TRAP RE-CONFIRMED AND STILL TO BE IGNORED: the hsv.de "Verletzungsupdate zu Sambi Lokonga" is 09.02.2026 = last season. No current exit rumours (the "Wir haben hier ein Projekt" item is 01.05.2026, stale). EXECUTION ORDER MATTERS: buy Pinckert FIRST, sell Lokonga SECOND. Selling first drops the squad to ten and exposes the -100 penalty; buying first puts him at twelve and the sale returns him to eleven. Resulting shape 1 GK / 5 DEF / 2 MID / 3 ATT = 5-2-3; if that formation is not offered, sell Conte (9.631.050, ap 47, fit but out of the Hoffenheim XI per Ilzer 04.09.2026) instead for 5-3-2, accepting 144.894 less and leaving the unavailable man in the eleven. CONDITIONAL BUT NO LONGER TIGHT: if the Pinckert auction is LOST the sale must not happen and the squad stays at eleven — however, unlike the Rohr episode, the auction resolves ~08.09 15:48Z, roughly 75h before the lock, so there is ample room to recover. Unwind deadline is the lock itself: a negative balance at MD3 start scores ZERO for the whole matchday.

buy.reason: Pinckert is the recommendation and the only one. He is a fit, confirmed starter in a settled back three per club-page and coach reporting dated within the last week, absent from the league injury table, with a points mean built on two full matchdays rather than a cameo, and he is listed at exactly market value. The problem is entirely the bid. The contested-Kickbase cluster clears well into double-digit premiums and the ceiling here sits below that cluster, because the ceiling is not set by appetite but by what the single funding sale realises. Bid the ceiling, expect to lose, and lose nothing if it goes. Three other names have real merit and die on money, not judgement: Bellingham, the cleanest midfield asset measured, expiring within hours; Schick, the best points-per-euro large asset the ledger has seen; and Coufal, whose defensive mean rivals Pinckert's but who is asked at nearly three times the top of the measured manager-ask band. Claude-Maurice remains the trap of the week — the best-looking ratio on the board, built on one substitute appearance, and independently confirmed this run as not in his club's starting eleven.

standing.name: Lukas Pinckert
standing.why: SUPERSEDES Bzq92nm (closed, price revised — not abandoned). Same player, same merit, bid raised to the hard affordability ceiling. MERIT RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN AND ONE LEDGER FACT CORRECTED: Pinckert is at SV ELVERSBERG, not Heidenheim — Heidenheim is NOT in the 26/27 Bundesliga (promoted: Schalke, Elversberg, Paderborn). PRICE IS THE WHOLE PROBLEM. Kickbase board listing at exactly mv 9.853.110, ofc 0, resolving ~2026-09-08T15:48Z. The measured contested-Kickbase cluster clears +16,71% / +16,96% / +20,96%, so the competitive bid is ~11,5M. HE CANNOT PAY IT. Cash 1.102.767 plus the only sale that funds this (Lokonga mv 9.775.944) = 10.878.711 = +10,41% over mv, and that is a HARD ceiling because a negative balance at the MD3 lock scores ZERO for the entire matchday. Bid 10.850.000 (+10,12%) leaves ~29k of headroom against the four 20:00Z mv ticks before the lock, which can move Lokonga's realisable price down. THIS BID IS BELOW THE WINNING CLUSTER AND WILL PROBABLY LOSE — bid it anyway, because a lost auction costs nothing and the upside is the largest single points swing available: Lokonga is unavailable (ap 44, acute back trouble) and Pinckert's ap 136 replaces him, roughly +92 per matchday. PAIRED WITH SELL of Lokonga; do not treat the two independently.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: CONDITIONAL ON THE 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK, WHICH IS 1h13m AWAY AND WILL VERY LIKELY PUT THE LIVE 10.250.000 OFFER UNDERWATER. This does not revise BUY Bsmq4uu (still open, still correct at the current ask); it is the contingency that Bsmq4uu itself asked the next run to price. STATE OF THE OFFER AT 18:45Z: listing prc 9.726.134 = exactly mv, ofc 1 with Georg alone in ofs at 10.250.000 = +5,39%, exs 22363 resolving ~2026-09-06T01:07Z. WHY THE TICK IS THE PROBLEM: Rohr posted ~115 points in MD2 (p 87 -> 202, ap 101) and mvt reads 1 (rising). Every Kickbase listing observed in this ledger carries prc == mv exactly, so the ask moves with the tick. The measured magnitude of a big-matchday tick, taken from this run's own squad sdmvt figures, is +9% to +34%: ter Horst scored 143 and moved +2.244.127 on 8.797.749 = +25,5%; Onyeka scored 139 and moved +2.024.477 on 9.286.468 = +21,8%; Conte scored 106 and moved +1.284.273 on 9.292.405 = +13,8%; Gregoritsch 195 -> +11,8%; Minjae 110 -> +11,8%; Matsima 138 -> +9,0%. Rohr at ~115 sits squarely in that band, so a post-tick mv of roughly 10,7M to 12,2M is the central expectation and +5,39% of headroom does not cover it. THE DECISION RULE, so the 20:45Z run does not re-derive it: re-read list_market at 20:05Z. (a) If the new prc is at or under 10.250.000, do nothing - the standing offer still clears. (b) If the new prc is above 10.250.000 but the affordability ceiling still covers it, RAISE to the ceiling. (c) If the new prc exceeds the ceiling, the buy is DEAD on affordability and the offer should be pulled rather than left to fail. THE CEILING MUST BE RECOMPUTED AT 20:05Z, NOT REUSED FROM HERE - this is the trap in this call. It is cash 1.002.767 plus the single sale a post-buy squad of 12 permits, and BOTH unwind legs move at the same tick in OPPOSITE directions. Lokonga is mvt 2 FALLING with sdmvt -1.125.317 and scored only 44, so his 9.731.816 will probably shrink; Conte is mvt 1 RISING with sdmvt +1.284.273 and scored 106, so his 9.292.405 will probably grow. Take the LARGER of the two post-tick values: selling Lokonga leaves 1/5/2/3 = 5-2-3 fielding 1283, selling Conte leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2 fielding 1280, a three-point difference that is not worth defending against a cash difference of a million. 10.734.583 recorded here is the PRE-TICK Lokonga-route ceiling and is a placeholder for that computation. WHY RAISING IS RIGHT RATHER THAN MERELY TOLERABLE, WHICH THE HEADLINE PRICE HIDES: the purchase is not P for 101 points, it is (P minus the unwind proceeds) for the NET points gain. Post-buy-and-unwind the eleven goes 1226 -> 1283, i.e. +57 fielded points, for a net cash outlay of P - 9.731.816. At the current 10.250.000 that is 518.184 for +57 = 9,1k per marginal point; even at the full 10.734.583 ceiling it is 1.002.767 for +57 = 17,6k per marginal point. Set that against the bar this ledger has been applying to everything else on the board - Conte 107k, Kosugi 351k rejected, Demirovic 465k, Robin Koch 184k gross - and Rohr is an order of magnitude better than anything else available. So the ceiling is a hard money constraint and NOT a judgement that the extra premium is unattractive: pay it if it fits. AND PER H5om1wi, RAISING ON A KICKBASE LISTING BUYS WIN PROBABILITY, because these are highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice - this is the exact configuration in which the Makengo bid was held at +13,03% and lost to +60,76%. ofc 1 now is a snapshot, not a forecast, and the listing sits six hours out, which is the late-contest window that doctrine describes. NEWS VERIFIED THIS RUN, ALL DATED 05.09.2026: he started at CB and played the full 90 in Elversberg's 4:3 win at Gladbach (news.de match report, 05.09.2026, no substitution and no injury noted); Ligainsider's Elversberg page has him in the XI and Elversberg's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte entries are only Seifert and Zimmerschied; he is absent from Ligainsider's league-wide injury table read this run. st 0. He is now 3/3 starts. Fitness and selection are not in question - only the price is.

killed_this_run.name: Vladimír Coufal (Borussia Rumpelfuß manager ask)

Per H8t606f a manager ask is not the price, but +11,32% is nearly three times the top of the measured band — an offer at mv would be the only sane approach and there is no reason to think Rumpelfuss takes it while the ask is fresh. The same 10,88M is already committed to Pinckert, who costs a third as much for essentially the same ap. Re-check only if Coufal is still unsold in several days at an ask at or below mv AND the Pinckert structure has resolved.

killed_this_run.name: Santiago Castañeda (Daggi D. manager ask)
killed_this_run.why: A MANAGER ASK PRICED IN THE KICKBASE CLUSTER, WHICH IS THE ONE THING A MANAGER ASK MAY NOT DO. Daggi D. posted him 2026-09-06T20:47:51Z, two minutes after the last run read the market, and posted Onyedika (Akyneq5) five minutes before that - same seller, same shelf-clearing pattern as Volte_28 in A8pgzkd. MID, tid 29 = SC PADERBORN (same club as ter Horst), mv 9.406.105, ask 10.589.799 = +12,59% over mv, mvt 1 rising, no expiry so it sits until the lock. REJECTED ON PRICE AGAINST THE RIGHT BAND, WHICH IS THE POINT OF LOGGING IT: manager-to-manager asks in this league clear in the LOW single digits (measured +3,06%, +4,35%) because a manager ask is seller's choice, not highest-bid-wins - the high cluster (+16,71%, +16,96%, +20,96%, +60,76%) belongs to CONTESTED KICKBASE listings and does not license this ask. Benchmarked correctly, +12,59% is roughly three times the going manager-ask premium. REJECTED ON POINTS TOO, AND THIS IS THE DECISIVE LEG: p 165 ap 83 over two appearances, versus Pinckert 136 at 9.853.110. Castaneda costs 128k per fielded point against Pinckert's 72k, and he would consume 10.589.799 of a 10.878.711 unwind ceiling - i.e. buying him spends essentially the whole of Georg's single-buy capacity on the worse of the two players and leaves 288.912 of headroom. He is the direct substitute for the Pinckert buy and he loses on both legs at once. NO FITNESS CASE EITHER WAY: st 0 and Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table does not list him; this is a value rejection, not an availability one. REVERSAL: only if the ask drops to at or below mv 9.406.105 AND the Pinckert auction has already been lost AND a dated Paderborn XI at that time starts him.

killed_this_run.name: Jobe Bellingham
killed_this_run.why: THE CLEANEST MID ASSET THIS LEDGER HAS MEASURED AND HE DIES ON THE CEILING, NOT ON MERIT - log the merit in full so a liquid future run does not re-derive it. New Kickbase board listing 2026-09-06T20:57:13Z (feed t:3), twelve minutes after the last run read the market. MID, tid 3 = BORUSSIA DORTMUND, prc exactly mv 18.039.623, ofc 0, st 0, mvt 1 RISING, exs 56781 resolving ~2026-09-07T14:31Z. MERIT: p 247 ap 124 over TWO FULL STARTS, not a cameo mean - get_player_performance 26/27 gives MD1 v HSV 97 minutes st 5 for 156, MD2 at Hoffenheim 99 minutes st 5 for 91. That is 196 of a possible ~196 minutes, the highest participation of any candidate this run. Ligainsider's league-wide Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table read this run lists Dortmund's absentees as Emre Can (Kreuzbandriss, 6+ months) and Samuele Inacio (red-card ban) and does NOT list him. FIXTURE IS THE BEST ON THE BOARD: MD3 is Dortmund at HOME v Paderborn (12.09.2026), i.e. the strongest side in this shortlist against the weakest opponent, where Pinckert's MD3 is Elversberg at home v BAYERN. WHY IT IS STILL A NO: the single-buy unwind ceiling this run is 10.878.711 (cash 1.102.767 + Lokonga mv 9.775.944, the only sale a 12-man squad permits without dropping under eleven). 18.039.623 is 1,66x that ceiling and there is no second sale available - selling Lokonga AND Widmer takes the squad to nine and forces two buys, which is a smaller per-buy budget, not a bigger one. He is not affordable at any structure Georg can reach before the MD3 lock. MARGINAL POINTS IF HE EVER IS AFFORDABLE: as a MID he displaces Lokonga's zero, so the purchase is +124 for 18,0M = 145k per marginal point - worse than Pinckert's 72k, so even with money he ranks BEHIND Pinckert, and this is the important half of the record. REVERSAL: only if he is relisted at a time when the unwind ceiling covers the ask AND no better points-per-euro starter is on the board at that moment.
